summary: Inspected 15 representative files across the alloc module (alloc.v, borrow.v, boxed.v, rc.v, sync.v, collections/mod.v, vec/links/mod.v, links/alloc.v, links/boxed.v, links/raw_vec.v, links/slice.v, vec/links/into_iter.v, simulate/boxed.v, simulate/slice.v, simulations_legacy/vec.v, fmt.v). All files contain formal Coq/Rocq mathematical content: definitions, axioms, lemmas, typeclass instances, module structures, and simulation proofs. No files are pure import aggregators; every file declares or proves formal mathematical content relevant to the Rocq-of-Rust formalization of Rust's alloc library.
